rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy:
36 Inch French Door Refrigerator with TwinChill™
Perfect for any home, this French door refrigerator offers a spacious 27.6 cubic feet of storage space. The refrigerator features four adjustable spill-proof shelves. One Quick Space shelf slides under itself to quickly make room for taller items. Two humidity-controlled produce crispers keep fruits and vegetables fresher longer. A full-width electronic temperature-controlled drawer with colored LED lights features three accurate settings to deliver the optimal temperature for your favorite foods while colored lights indicate the chosen setting. Six door bins can hold gallon-sized containers, giving you plenty of room for storing other items like tall beverage bottles and bottles and jars of condiments.

The refrigerator also houses the Space Saving ice maker, freeing up space within the refrigerator. An integrated water filter provides filtered water for the external dispenser and ice maker. The freezer includes two large sections behind the gliding freezer drawer for storing leftovers, ice cream, and meats for the week, and a removable basket.

Peace of mind is ensured by a limited 1-Year Parts & Labor Warranty on the entire appliance.

product.description:
Features:

  • 15.71 cu. ft. fresh food compartment and 8.57 cu. ft. frozen food compartment
  • Find even the smallest items easily with an entire back wall of LEDs that illuminate your entire refrigerator with crisp, white light
  • Access fresh fruits and vegetables quickly and easily thanks to well-designed, clear soft close crisper drawers so your fresh favorites are always at your fingertips
  • Easily store and access your favorites, including taller items like re-corked wine bottles, with an innovative door in door design and convenient rotating bines
  • Refrigerator comes ready to automatically create filtered ice

Product Highlights:

Fingerprint Resistant Stainless: Easily wipe away smudges and fingerprints for a look that's always sparkling clean

Dual-Evaporators: This dual evaporator refrigerator features TwinChill™ evaporator climate zones in the fresh food and freezer sections, which help keep food at optimum freshness

Removable Bin Caddy: Enjoy more storage flexibility and better organization with a refrigerator caddy that can store a range of items and be used as an adjustable drawer divider

Hands-Free Autofill: Hands-free AutoFill uses sensors in the refrigerator dispenser to release the exact amount of filtered water you want, so you can walk away while your bottle fills up

Specifications:

  • Refrigerator Capacity: 15.71 Cu. Ft.
  • Freezer Capacity: 8.57 Cu. Ft.
  • Total Capacity: 27.9 Cu. Ft.
  • Bulb Type: LED
  • Refrigerator Shelves: Glass
  • Counter Depth: No
  • Crisper Bins: Yes
  • Gallon Door Storage: Yes
  • Height: 69-7/8"
  • Depth: 36-3/4"
  • Width: 35-5/8"
  • Amperage: 15A
  • Voltage: 120V
